description: Token optimization pipeline performance and cost savings analysis

panels.title: Optimization Summary
panels.description: Key metrics for the token optimization pipeline: total savings, efficiency rate, and processing overhead

panels.title: Input Tokens Optimized
panels.description: Total input tokens saved by the optimizer pipeline (all techniques). Optimizer only operates on the input/request side.

panels.title: Output Tokens Optimized
panels.description: Output tokens saved by response trimming. Shows 0 until response optimization is triggered by actual AI traffic.

panels.title: Cost Savings (USD)
panels.description: Estimated cost savings in USD from token optimization. Calculated from chars saved divided by 4 chars per token, multiplied by per-model pricing.

panels.title: Optimization Runs
panels.description: Total number of optimization pipeline executions in the selected time range

panels.title: Optimization Efficiency
panels.description: Percentage of input tokens saved by the optimizer. Higher = more effective compression.

panels.title: Avg Duration (ms)
panels.description: P50 and P95 optimizer pipeline duration in milliseconds. Measures total optimization overhead.

panels.title: Savings Over Time
panels.description: Time series showing optimization savings and cost reduction over the selected period

panels.title: Units Saved Over Time
panels.description: Estimated tokens saved per second by the optimizer over time

panels.title: Cost Savings Over Time
panels.description: Hourly cost savings from optimization over time in USD

panels.title: Optimization by Technique
panels.description: Per-technique token optimization metrics: chars saved, run frequency, and savings breakdown

panels.title: Chars Saved by Technique
panels.description: Stacked characters saved over time per optimization technique (input direction)

panels.title: Savings by Technique
panels.description: Total characters saved per technique in the selected time range (horizontal bar chart)

panels.title: Runs by Technique
panels.description: Stacked optimization run rate per technique showing execution frequency

panels.title: Before vs After
panels.description: Comparison of token counts before and after optimization, plus optimization rate over time

panels.title: Before vs After Optimization
panels.description: Bargauge comparing raw input tokens vs optimized tokens. Difference = tokens saved by optimization.

panels.title: Optimization Rate Over Time
panels.description: Percentage of input tokens saved by optimization over time

panels.title: Optimizer Performance (P95)
panels.description: P95 waste scan duration over time. Measures overhead of the waste detection pipeline.

panels.title: Technique Detail Table
panels.description: Detailed per-technique performance table with chars saved, run counts, and averages

panels.title: Technique Performance
panels.description: Summary table: chars saved and run count per technique. Sorted by chars saved descending.

panels.title: Budget & Waste
panels.description: Budget utilization level and waste detection findings across all detectors

panels.title: Budget Level
panels.description: Average budget level across models. 0=green, 1=yellow, 2=red. Shows 0 until AI requests flow through.

panels.title: Waste Detection
panels.description: Waste findings grouped by detector. Each finding represents detected wasteful tokens.

panels.title: Wasted Units by Detector
panels.description: Tokens wasted per detector type. Helps identify which waste patterns are most common.

panels.title: Thai Compression (Pordee)
panels.description: Thai text compression system that reduces token usage for Thai language content

panels.title: Pordee Injections
panels.description: Total Thai compression injections in the selected time range

panels.title: Avg Output Ratio
panels.description: Median and P95 output compression ratio. Lower = better compression.

panels.title: Avg Duration (ms)
panels.description: P50 and P95 Thai compression processing time in milliseconds

panels.title: Injections by Result
panels.description: Injection results over time grouped by outcome (e.g. compressed, skipped, error)

panels.title: Injections by Level
panels.description: Distribution of injections by compression level. Higher levels = more aggressive compression.

panels.title: Optimizer Duration
panels.description: P50 and P95 total optimizer pipeline duration. Includes all technique execution time.

panels.title: Optimizer Tokens Saved
panels.description: Total estimated tokens saved by the optimizer across input and output directions

panels.title: Total Cost Savings
panels.description: Cumulative estimated cost savings from all optimization techniques

panels.title: Optimizer Duration Over Time
panels.description: P95 optimizer execution duration over time. Spikes may indicate large or complex payloads.

panels.title: Chunker Performance
panels.description: Chunker metrics: total chunks created, cache hit rate, and reorder performance

panels.title: Total Chunks
panels.description: Total chunks created by the chunker for stable content reordering

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Percentage of chunks that matched a cached version, avoiding reprocessing

panels.title: Chunks Over Time
panels.description: Chunk creation rate over time, grouped by chunk type

panels.title: Sketch & Delta
panels.description: Sketch-based deduplication and delta encoding: detect duplicate content and encode only differences

panels.title: Sketch Hamming Similarity
panels.description: Distribution of Hamming similarity scores between content sketches. High similarity = duplicate content detected.

panels.title: Delta Savings %
panels.description: Percentage of characters saved by delta encoding. Shows how much content was reused vs resent.

panels.title: Image Compression
panels.description: Image optimization: resize, convert to JPEG, and strip metadata to reduce base64 payload size

panels.title: Images Compressed
panels.description: Total images processed through the image compression pipeline

panels.title: Bytes Saved
panels.description: Total bytes saved by image compression (resize + format conversion)

panels.title: Bytes Original
panels.description: Total bytes of images before compression

panels.title: Savings Rate
panels.description: Percentage of image bytes saved by compression

panels.title: Disclosure
panels.description: Progressive disclosure metrics: FTS hit rate and chars saved by layered context disclosure

panels.title: FTS Hit Rate
panels.description: Full-text search layer hit rate. Measures how often the disclosure layer finds matching content in cached context.

panels.title: FTS Hit Rate Over Time
panels.description: Full-text search layer hit rate over time. High rate = progressive disclosure is effectively skipping unchanged context.

title: AI Platform - Text Optimization
